author: Topsy
description:
April was another review-heavy month, with no fewer than 8 unboxings covering over 16 kits and products! We also made the trip to Salute in London and have our full impressions to share, and Stahly has rediscovered his love for painting Aeldari. All that and more in this roundup of our best posts from April 2026.
